title: This sleek, fold-flat MagSafe stand is down to its lowest price ever (23% off)
content:
Macworld

Twelve South Curve Nano MagSafe

View Deal

If you’re constantly fiddling with the perfect angle for your FaceTime calls and video sessions, now’s the perfect chance to get your hands on one of the slimmest and most adjustable MagSafe phone stands you can get. The Twelve South Curve Nano MagSafe stand is only $27 at Amazon right now, which is quite the discount from its $35 MSRP. That’s a small price to pay for such a useful little accessory.

The magic starts when you bring your phone close. The built-in magnetic ring grabs onto any MagSafe iPhone, snapping it into place with a satisfying click and holding it securely. There’s no fiddling and no awkward balancing act. Getting the perfect view is effortless, and the Curve Nano adjusts smoothly to just about any angle, so you can tilt it upright for a work call or swing your phone into landscape mode for movies or shows.

The Curve Nano is extremely portable, weighing next to nothing and folding completely flat. The package even comes with a travel sleeve so it won’t get scratched when you toss it into your backpack or luggage. You’ll have a proper phone stand ready for video calls from hotel rooms or hands-free entertainment. You won’t have to worry about it slipping either, because it comes with a steady base and soft silicone padding.

Just keep in mind that the Twelve South Curve Nano is only a stand, not a charger, and it only works with MagSafe-compatible devices. But if you just want a low-fi solution for your calls, don’t miss out on the chance to get this super cute and slim stand while it’s still on sale.
